points: Yirmiyahu brings the Rechavim, descendants of Yisro, into a room in the Bais Hamikdash and offers them wine.
They refuse. Their ancestor Yonadav ben Rechav told them never to drink wine, build homes, or plant, only to live in tents, and they keep it.
Hashem says: learn from them. They keep a tradition from their ancestor, and you ignore message after message from Me.
Because they listened, the Rechavim are promised they will not be destroyed.
When we see devout people of other faiths holding on to their traditions, it's a demand on us: do we have that same commitment?
